No, but we could chat next week if that works for you

No, chat soon ?

Custom Mode
Build it yourself
Custom Mode lets you define how Superwhisper thinks, writes, and formats. Down to the finest detail.
Beyond tone – precision control
Set formatting rules, structure preferences, and even specialized prompts for different tasks.
Pick the right model for the job
Choose from top-tier models like GPT, Claude, or Llama to balance speed, accuracy, and complexity.
Refine for every situation

Works anywhere
you can type
Slack, Cursor, Notion...

Beep boop
Faster agentic workflows
Use Superwhisper with Cursor, Claude Code, Open Code, Amp, Codex, or any other agentic coding app, without touching your keyboard.
Works where you code
Superwhisper integrates seamlessly so you can drive an entire fleet of agents faster than you can type.
Less typing, more building
Allow agents to one shot your next feature by giving them more context. Talk through your change and skip the typing.
